# Laila · twenty businesses, one LINE

> A pitch from motdang.net Co., Ltd. to Laila Group, Chiang Rai, Thailand: one LINE control panel for all of Laila's businesses, shown as ten working demos.

- Laila Group: 869/51 Thai Viwat Alley, Wiang, Mueang Chiang Rai 57000 · +66 84 739 9996 · tours, slow boat to Laos, cars and scooters
- Laila Money Exchange (Laila Luxe Co., Ltd.): 48–49 Thai Wiwat Alley, Chiang Rai · 053-160611 · https://laila-exchange.nanobotco.workers.dev/
- Laila's Visa Services: 48–49 Thai Wiwat Alley, Chiang Rai · 065-551-4499 · https://www.visaservicesthailand.com
- Laila's Designer Consignment: Thai Wiwat Alley, Chiang Rai
- Chiang Mai Visa Desk: https://chiangmaivisadesk.com/
